texts.facts: However, a company by name Anipra Chemical Private Limted is using the said chemical in producing chemical with 1722 Mg./Ltd. The 5-pil-88-2017.odt said Caramel is used in other food products, which are also consumed by children. The products, whose names have been disclosed in the petition, are Bournvita, Boost, Horlicks and all bakery products. The petitioner, therefore, prays for search to be undertaken under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and stop the production of Caramel chemical Pandharinath Shankarrao Sable vs The Chief Secretary Mantralaya Mumbai ... on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176003681/ 1 which is of excess limit and also take cognizance on the complaints/representations made by him.
texts.arguments: 2. The petitioner wants to raise a so called issue of public interest in respect of licence to the companies which are manufacturing the raw material for production of food items, in which Caramel chemical is used having 4-methyl imidazole, which is harmful to the body and may lead to diseases like cancer. It is stated that FSSAI permitted the prescribed limit for using 4-methyl imidazole in food product and that limit is 300-200 Mg./Ltd.
